description: List the posts planned on the business's content calendar from today on, by day, for one platform or all. Each post has post_id, platform, topic, planned_on, text, hashtags, image_idea, written_by (template or owner) and character_limit; can_edit says whether this account may change them. Nothing is posted. Any member; Live and Pro. Requires company:read; the account selects the business.
name: get_content_calendar
title: Get my posting calendar
